name: todo-api
description: REST API for a signed-in End User's personal todo list: list, create, update, and delete todos scoped to the caller. Sits behind the development API platform gateway, which only forwards requests carrying a valid Dataplane Thunder (T2) token; a Platform Thunder (T1) token is rejected. Does not serve any UI, and does not expose any endpoint outside the caller's own todos.

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores each End User's todos, keyed by owner.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Verifies the caller's Dataplane Thunder session on every request.
